units.claim: Ur-presentation is not an appearing of ur-presences that only afterwards take on intentionality, but a continual appearing of them in the mode of fulfillment of expectation-intentions.
units.quote: the ur-presentation is not a mere appearing of ur-presences that would only subsequently take on intentionality, but a continual appearing of them in the mode of fulfillment of expectation-intentions.

units.claim: An empty concrete retention can find fulfillment only through a recollection that quasi-constitutes the same perception anew, and fulfillment in reverse running is impossible.
units.quote: There is a primal law: an empty concrete retention can find fulfillment only through a recollection that (quasi-)constitutes anew the concrete perception of the same event in the mode of "re-consciousness" (*Wiederbewußtsein*).

units.claim: Every middle phase of the primal process has a triple face, being retention of elapsed ur-data, retention of elapsed apprehensions, and fulfilled expectation from which an empty horizon of unfulfilled expectation radiates.
units.quote: Every constituting total-phase is retention of fulfilled protention, which is the limit of a horizon of unfulfilled and itself continuously mediate protention (a stretch-continuum).

units.claim: Consciousness becomes both retentional and protentional continuity, steadily fulfillable such that every fulfillment is simultaneously intention for a new fulfillment.
units.quote: In essence, it is steadily fulfillable such that every fulfillment is simultaneously intention for a new fulfillment, and so on.

units.claim: The objection that retentionally conscious fulfillments generate an infinite regress of higher protentions is dismissed as a verbal entanglement that yields no vicious regress.
units.quote: But Husserl dismisses this as a mere verbal entanglement: the protention not yet fulfilled passes into a fulfillment (a mode of the new protention), which passes into a new fulfillment

units.claim: The primal process is an infinite protentional process in which each entering phase accords with the preceding tendency and is itself tendency on what is coming.
units.quote: Tendency is a consciousness-mode, and what enters in accord with it is conscious as such and is in turn tendency on what is "coming." Each phase is intention and fulfillment into infinity.

units.claim: The Now is the form of the correlate of a consciousness-point of maximal fulfillment, an edge-point where the half-planes of intensification and sinking meet.
units.quote: "Now" is the form of the correlate of a consciousness-point of maximal fulfillment, i.e., an edge-point.

units.claim: The zero-point of each phase is consciousness of saturation, the null of positive tendency, identified with originary consciousness of the bodily self-there.
units.quote: The zero-point is consciousness of saturation—the null of positive tendency, "fulfilledness."

units.claim: Now-being alone is actually-being, given in the consciousness of fulfillment, while past and future are given as past Now and future Now.
units.quote: Now-being alone is "actually-being"—what is given in the consciousness of fulfillment.
